seo_title: Cost of Living in Almaty 2026: Visa, Prices, Reviews | Relocost
seo_description: How much does it cost to live in Almaty per month, do Russians need a visa, work, rent and reviews from those who relocated. A realistic moving budget in the Relocost calculator.
intro_text: The easiest move for Russian citizens: the Russian language, familiar infrastructure, working bank cards and mountains just an hour away. A large Russian-speaking community lives here and bureaucracy is minimal.
